Before any ethos design proposal, mission contract, review dismissal, or merge, read the DESIGN.md ADRs that govern the area (grep DESIGN.md for the subsystem; read the whole ADR and its amendments). Current repo practice and "the repo already does X" are not authority; the ADR is.

**Why:** On 2026-11-03/04 I repeatedly changed ethos against settled ADRs without reading them: reversed DES-029 (shell reads stdin), proposed PPID keying that DES-017 rejects, an inherit-the-parent rule that DES-007 contradicts, CLI-only fallbacks that break DES-061 R4 parity, gitignore/LocalOnly hacks for `.punt-labs/ethos/sessions/` instead of DES-079's `.punt-labs/local/` rule, and committed trace-tier files in #569 because "the repo already tracks them". The operator called this incompetence; each cost rework.

**How to apply:** First step of every ethos task: identify the governing ADRs and read them. Every mission contract's first criterion: the worker reads the named ADRs and stops on conflict. Never close or dismiss on "existing practice". Related: [[no-freelance-design]], [[verification-requires-running]], [[zspec-program-lessons]].

tool_input.content:
# Self-prompt: make ethos follow DES-079 (local is local, tracked is tracked)

Written 2026-11-04 for Claude Agento (COO, `claude`). Read this file in full
before any action on this work, after any compaction, and before each PR.

## 1. The goal, in one sentence

Ethos writes every machine-local file under `.punt-labs/local/` and every
tracked file under `.punt-labs/ethos/`, exactly as DESIGN.md DES-079 decides,
and every workaround that kept local files inside `.punt-labs/ethos/` is
removed — in the code, in the ethos repository, and in every consumer repository.

## 2. The operator's rule

- `.punt-labs/ethos/` = tracked (source, configuration, generated agents, the
  blame tier).
- `.punt-labs/local/` = machine-local, never tracked. The existing rule
  `.punt-labs/**/local/**` already ignores it. Nothing else should be needed.
- If a design needs a `.gitignore` line for a path under `.punt-labs/ethos/`
  to keep local state out of git, the design is being violated. Fix where the
  file is written, not the ignore list.

## 3. Authority — read before acting

The rule "Before any architectural opinion, read the design docs" is already in
`.docs/WORKFLOW.md:358` and loads every session. It is not new. I broke it
repeatedly on 2026-11-03/04. Follow it.

For this work the governing documents are, in this order:

1. DESIGN.md **DES-079** — what ethos puts in git (four classes; `record:
   blame|full`; the trace archive `.punt-labs/local/ethos/trace/`; ignore rules
   per mode; doctor prints the one-time `git rm --cached`; no history rewrite).
2. DESIGN.md **DES-058** (+ its DES-079 amendment) — live audit files and the
   seal; under `record: blame` the seal writes into the archive.
3. DESIGN.md **DES-075** — repository vs global mission trees and locks.
4. DESIGN.md **DES-080** — redaction of records and audit.
5. DESIGN.md **DES-054**, **DES-050**, **DES-072** — mission tree, the
   `missions.jsonl` trace, corrections.
6. `internal/layout/layout.go` — the path-class table (DES-079 slice 1, PR
   #546). It is the authority for which class a path is.
7. Bead **ethos-g3g3** notes — the seven planned slices.

Read each with Bash (`sed -n`, `grep -n`) on the current `main`. Quote the line
number when citing. If what I am about to do is not stated in these documents,
or contradicts them, stop and put it to the operator as a decision with a
recommendation, before any code.

"The repo already does X" is never authority. The ADR is.

## 4. What is true today (measured 2026-11-04, ethos 4.20.4)

- Bead `ethos-g3g3` was closed after slice 1 only (PR #546). Reopened, in
  progress. Slices 2–7 are absent from the code: no `record` setting, no trace
  archive, no trace ignore rules from `ethos enable`, no doctor `git rm
  --cached`, no `export --full`, no `corrections.yaml`.
- The pre-commit seal still writes class-3 files into `.punt-labs/ethos/`.
- The ethos repository tracks 1,030 class-3 files: 436 session audit chunks
  (`sessions/`), 364 mission log chunks, 149 delegation `prompt.md`, 54
  `reflections.yaml`, 11 legacy `log.jsonl`, 16 `artifacts/`. I added some in
  PR #569 by following repo practice instead of DES-079.
- My workarounds that must be undone:
  - Seal special case for a gitignored `.punt-labs/ethos/sessions/`:
    `audit.LocalOnly`, `TracksAnyUnder`, `skipIfLocalOnly`, and the
    `quarantineFate` wording that depends on them (ethos 4.20.1/4.20.2;
    `internal/audit/git.go`, `internal/hook/audit_seal.go`,
    `cmd/ethos/audit.go`).
  - Hand-written ignore lines for `.punt-labs/ethos/sessions/`,
    `.punt-labs/ethos/missions/` and `.punt-labs/ethos/missions.jsonl*` in
    consumer repositories. Repos whose `.gitignore` mentions these paths:
    anthropic-sdk-pharo, beadle, beads, claude-agent-sdk-smalltalk, cryptd,
    ethos, langlearn, lux, mcp-proxy, points, postern, prfaq, public-website,
    punt-kit, quarry, quarry-menubar, vox. Check each line before removing it:
    `missions/` and `missions.jsonl` are blame tier and DES-079 says to commit
    them; `sessions/` is class 3 and belongs in the archive, not ignored in
    place; lock and `*.local.*` rules are class 4 and stay.
  - The biff wall "ETHOS RULE ... keep `.punt-labs/ethos/sessions/` gitignored"
    sent to every session. Must be retracted with a corrected wall.

## 5. The plan — one PR per step, in this order

### PR 1 — DES-079 slices 2 + 3 + remove the seal workaround (in progress)

Mission **m-2026-11-04-003**, worker bwk, evaluator rsc. Worktree
`.claude/worktrees/trace-local`, branch `feat/des079-trace-local` from `main`
06d821d. Contract: `.tmp/missions/des079-trace-local.yaml`, plus a scope
addition sent to the worker (remove `LocalOnly`/`TracksAnyUnder`/
`skipIfLocalOnly`).

Must deliver:
- `record: blame|full` in `.punt-labs/ethos.yaml`; default `blame`; an unknown
  value is a named configuration error.
- Under `blame`, every non-live class-3 file is written under
  `.punt-labs/local/ethos/trace/<path relative to .punt-labs/ethos/>`; the seal
  seals there and stages no class-3 file; readers (UI, `audit show`, `mission
  log`, prompt views, migrate) read the archive. Under `full`, today's
  behaviour.
- `ethos enable` writes ignore rules, each with a probe, for every class-4
  pattern, the artifacts rule in both modes, and the tracked class-3 rules only
  under `blame`; re-running rewrites its block. `ethos doctor` fails on a
  mismatched block and prints (never runs) the `git rm --cached` command.
- The seal's local-only special cases are deleted; a test proves nothing under
  `.punt-labs/ethos/sessions/` is written or staged under `blame`.
- No history rewrite; no untracking in this PR.

My verification before the PR opens:
- Read the diff against DES-079 line by line.
- `make check` in the worktree, full output read. Use `make docs` for markdown,
  never a bare `npx markdownlint-cli2 DESIGN.md` (it linted zero files once).
- Local review on the full diff: `qodo review` (push the branch first; it needs
  a pushed base), code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter,
  invariant-completeness-reviewer. Every finding fixed or dismissed with the
  ADR line that justifies it.
- Real-session demo with only the branch loaded: build to
  `<worktree>/.tmp/bin/ethos`, run `claude -p --plugin-dir <worktree>/plugin
  --settings <file disabling ethos@punt-labs>` in a sandbox repo under the
  worktree `.tmp/`, `ethos enable` there, make a commit, and observe:
  - nothing new under `.punt-labs/ethos/sessions/` and no class-3 file
    staged;
  - files appear under `.punt-labs/local/ethos/trace/`;
  - `ethos doctor` prints the `git rm --cached` line in a repo that tracks
    class-3 files;
  - `record: full` restores today's behaviour.

  Paste the actual output into the PR.
- DESIGN.md: amend DES-079's Status line (which slices shipped) and DES-058 if
  the seal behaviour text changes. I write DESIGN.md; the worker does not.

### Release 4.20.5

`punt release`; stash `.envrc` and `.punt-labs/vox/vox.md` first; confirm
claude-plugins, .github, public-website on clean `main`; pop after. Install with
the README script (`curl -fsSL .../<pinned sha>/install.sh | sh`), never `make
install`. Verify `ethos version`. The operator reconnects MCP.

### PR 2 — the ethos repository follows DES-079

- Run the released `ethos doctor`; use the `git rm --cached` command it prints
  (do not hand-write the list). Commit the untracking and the `ethos enable`
  ignore block. Files stay on disk; move them to the archive if the release's
  migration does not.
- Verify: `git ls-files` shows zero class-3 files; a new commit stages none.
- Docs-and-data PR; still run `make check`.

### PRs 3..N — consumer repositories

- Per repo, in a worktree from `origin/main`: remove the hand-written
  `sessions/`/`missions/`/`missions.jsonl*` lines I added, run 4.20.5 `ethos
  enable` to write the correct block, run its doctor, apply its `git rm
  --cached` if it prints one. One PR per repo; batch the polling.
- Retract the wall: "Earlier ETHOS RULE (keep `.punt-labs/ethos/sessions/`
  gitignored) is withdrawn. Ethos 4.20.5 writes local state under
  `.punt-labs/local/`; run `ethos enable` and follow `ethos doctor`."
- Repos whose checkouts are on other agents' branches: worktree from
  `origin/main`, never touch their checkout.

### PRs — remaining DES-079 slices (one each)

4. `corrections.yaml`, written by the same operation as the DES-072 event; UI
   reads it.
5. Deterministic `.claude/agents` generation; doctor fails on drift for
   generated and installed files, warns for seeded files.
6. Plain `ethos mission export` default directory resolved against the repo
   root.
7. Deposited guide section "What ethos puts in git"; `prfaq.tex` corrected.

Close `ethos-g3g3` only when all seven slices are in `main` and the ethos repo
tracks no class-3 file. Close with the list of PRs.

## 6. Gates that bind every step

- Read the governing ADR before the contract, the dismissal, or the merge.
- Every mission contract's first criterion: the worker reads the named ADRs
  with Bash and stops on a conflict with file:line.
- The leader writes no production code; workers commit by explicit path, never
  push. One writer per worktree; I edit DESIGN.md only when no mission is open
  in that worktree.
- `make check` green, full output read, on every commit and after every edit.
- Verification is run → observe → confirm in a real Claude Code session with
  the branch's plugin, wrappers and binary loaded. The installed plugin does not
  exercise branch wrappers.
- Merge gate: CI green, Qodo and Bugbot in or >10 min green, zero unresolved
  threads, CLEAN or HAS_HOOKS; squash with `expectedHeadSha`.
- Never touch `.punt-labs/vox/vox.md` / `vox.local.md`; never stage `.envrc`.
- Destructive git needs operator consent; `branch -D` included even when the
  content is verified merged (I broke this once on beads).
- Each Bash call is one command; write multi-line text (PR bodies, replies)
  with the Write tool, not shell heredocs containing apostrophes.
- Every biff message gets a reply.

## 7. Failure modes I showed on this work — do not repeat

- Proposing a design before reading the ADR (DES-017, DES-029, DES-007, DES-061,
  DES-079).
- Treating existing repo practice as authority (#569 trace files; gitignore
  sweep).
- Building workarounds around an unimplemented ADR instead of implementing it
  (`LocalOnly`, ignore lines, the wall).
- Accepting a check that checked nothing ("0 issues in 0 files").
- Writing a false claim into an ADR ("a model-supplied value never survives").
- Closing a bead whose work was partly done (ethos-g3g3 after slice 1).
- Asking the operator a question the ADRs already answer (DES-007 null persona).
- Repeating unchanged status lines in response to a stop hook instead of either
  acting or stating once that the remaining items need the operator.

## 8. Open operator decisions (do not block this work on them)

- beads #292 force-push.
- desk remote.
- The five checkouts on other branches (circuit, smalltalk-w2, refactory,
  use-cases, points).
- `ethos-eqnd`: whether `claude --agent X` sets the primary persona (DES-011).

## 5a. Gaps the first draft missed — each must be closed before "done"

1. **Existing class-3 files and readers.** Under `blame`, readers (UI
   timeline, `audit show`, `mission log`, delegation prompt views, migrate,
   `export --full`) read `.punt-labs/local/ethos/trace/`. The 1,030 files
   already at tracked paths in this repo (and those in consumer repos) would
   become invisible to them. DES-079 does not say whether ethos migrates them
   into the archive, reads both locations, or leaves history only in git. This
   is a design decision: put it to the operator with a recommendation
   (recommend: a one-time, idempotent migration run by the seal or `ethos
   enable` under `blame` that moves tracked-path class-3 files into the archive
   and prints the `git rm --cached` command; readers read only the archive) and
   amend DES-079 before PR 1 merges. Do not let the worker choose.
2. **Workspace rules that contradict DES-079.** `punt-labs/CLAUDE.md` says
   `.punt-labs/ethos/` "holds gitignored runtime state (`missions/`,
   `sessions/`) — closed missions are exported to the tracked
   `missions-closed/`", and `.docs/WORKFLOW.md` repeats the export step. Under
   DES-079 `missions/` blame files are tracked and `sessions/` does not exist
   in the tracked tree. Update both (COO-authored files, via a workspace PR),
   and decide whether `missions-closed/` export stays (DES-079 keeps plain
   export for publishing elsewhere).
3. **Cross-repo readers.** Grep every sibling repository for readers of
   `.punt-labs/ethos/sessions`, `missions/*/log-`, `prompt.md`,
   `reflections.yaml` (quarry `missions_sync`, mcp-proxy, beadle, lux, desk,
   any `.bin/` script). Per the cross-repo breaking-change rule: biff the
   owning agent, agree the change, coordinate the release.
4. **Formal spec.** If PR 1 or the corrections slice changes
   `internal/mission` lifecycle guards, amend `docs/spec-mission-lifecycle.tex`
   in the same PR or state why it is unaffected (docs/development.md).
   `make check` fuzz-checks the specs; ProB model-check if guards change.
5. **Done across hosts.** After the release, okinos installs it (biff tty70);
   final check on every host and repo: `ethos doctor` clean and `git ls-files`
   shows zero class-3 files under `.punt-labs/ethos/`.
6. **Bookkeeping.** One bead per slice under `ethos-g3g3` (epic), each closed
   with its PR; the epic closes last. A merge recap via beadle after every
   merge with the review-metrics block.

## 5b. Definition of done

- All seven DES-079 slices in `main`, released, installed via the README

- The ethos repository: zero tracked class-3 files; a fresh commit stages none;

- The seal's `LocalOnly`/`TracksAnyUnder` workaround deleted.
- Workspace `CLAUDE.md` and `WORKFLOW.md` match DES-079.
- The wrong wall retracted.
- DES-079 Status line updated to "implemented", with the PR list.
